QuestInfo.name: [King of Crowns] Shiny Crown Crafting
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Gather up 30 Shimmering Stars from monsters and take them to Cassandra. Just remember, you have to fight monsters around your level. No more than 11 lower, or 21 higher!
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra made you an awesome crown from those stars you gave her. Better put that thing on your head and get to making another. Stack 'em up!

default.0: I don't know that you have enough Shimmering Stars...
